component.name: CF Compass
component.summary: Practice competitive programming with a local-first workbench

description.p: CF Compass is a local-first companion for competitive programming practice. Browse and filter problems, organize study plans, review contests, and follow your training progress in one desktop workbench.
The built-in demonstration workspace is available offline. Connect a Codeforces handle when you want to synchronize public problem and submission data.

screenshot.caption: The main workbench with built-in demonstration data
